entradas.text: “Have a good day, Mr. Rayne.”
“We are at the end of our allocated time.”
“Enjoy your stay in Valgsland.”
“Thank you for the *warm* hospitality.”
entradas.menu: “Thank you for the *warm* hospitality.”

entradas.text: “Sarcasm, huh? Haven't heard that one before.”
“I am glad that at least we can agree on one matter.”
“Excuses. Is that it?”
“I won't sit idly while you insult me. The deal is off. We are finished here.”
entradas.menu: “I won't sit idly while you insult me. The deal is off. We are finished here.”

entradas.text: “I am definitely not staying after this.”
entradas.menu: “I am definitely not staying after this.”

entradas.text: “Have a safe trip back home, Mr. Rayne.”
“Suit yourself.”
“Suit yourself.”
He briefly scanned me from head to toe.
“I will. Have a good day, Chancellor Hegel.”
entradas.menu: “I will. Have a good day, Chancellor Hegel.”

entradas.text: “I think that we have come far. After all, we are standing here side by side instead of facing each other on a battlefield.”
entradas.menu: “I think that we have come far. After all, we are standing here side by side instead of facing each other on a battlefield.”

entradas.text: We shook hands as he stared me down.
“I must go back to work.”
“I sincerely hope you understand that the world doesn't work that way anymore, Mr. Rayne.”
“Mr. Rayne. Welcome to Valgsland.”
“No you don't. But you will answer to the people of your country.”
“Recognise Heljiland as Valgslandian territory and I am ready to come to the table.”
“That's it? Sure. I will announce it as soon as possible.”
entradas.menu: “That's it? Sure. I will announce it as soon as possible.”

entradas.text: “Why? What are you after?”
entradas.menu: “Why? What are you after?”

entradas.text: “We can do so much more through unity. However, not everyone wants that.”
“Is that a yes or a no?”
“Do not underestimate your people, Mr. Rayne, or it might be the end of you.”
“Perhaps in the past, but not anymore.”
“Then consider our trade deal sealed, Mr. Rayne.”
“There is no way I can do that.”
entradas.menu: “There is no way I can do that.”

entradas.text: “Are you saying that you're not only weak, but also can't own up to your mistakes?”
“Fine. Deal.”
entradas.menu: “Fine. Deal.”

entradas.text: “I reject. You are asking for too much.”
entradas.menu: “I reject. You are asking for too much.”

entradas.text: “I have no qualms about what has been negotiated so far.”
“Thank you.”
entradas.menu: “Thank you.”

entradas.text: “It's good to be here.”
entradas.menu: “It's good to be here.”

entradas.text: “So. Where do we begin?”
entradas.menu: “So. Where do we begin?”

entradas.text: “Then consider our trade deal sealed, Mr. Rayne.”
“I don't answer to you, Chancellor Hegel.”
entradas.menu: “I don't answer to you, Chancellor Hegel.”

entradas.text: He extended his hand for a handshake.
We shook hands on it.
entradas.menu: Shake hands.

entradas.text: I didn't shake his hand. He shrugged.
entradas.menu: Don't shake his hand.

entradas.text: He gestured towards the painting.
“After all, it was the people who brought imperialism to its knees.”
“This was made in 1776 by the famous Valgslandian painter, Otto Kiebern.”
I looked at the painting. It must've been over five meters tall. It was a battle scene. On the left side there were banners carried by Valgs; on the right, Sords.
He turned around and walked away, leaving me alone in the empty halls of the Royal Palace.
“To be honest, you do not surprise me, Mr. Rayne.”
Countless spears formed a triangle at the center. The sky was red from the blood.
Hegel frowned.
“What do you think about it?”
Hegel frowned.
Hegel frowned.
“Listen, Mr. Rayne.”
“What I want is simple.”
“Nothing. It's just a painting.”
entradas.menu: “Nothing. It's just a painting.”

entradas.text: “It is a reminder. One misstep and we are back to painting the world with more blood.”
entradas.menu: “It is a reminder. One misstep and we are back to painting the world with more blood.”

entradas.text: “Let me tell you this, Mr. Rayne.”
“I do.”
“You have the gall to say that after all this?”
entradas.menu: “You have the gall to say that after all this?”

entradas.text: “Let's hear it. What do you want?”
entradas.menu: “Let's hear it. What do you want?”

entradas.text: “You are making it less likely with every minute passing.”
entradas.menu: “You are making it less likely with every minute passing.”

entradas.text: “You have come here for a trade deal.”
“You started privatizing your economy and sold state assets to make the rich even richer.”
“As the leaders of this world, we must be careful, Mr. Rayne.”
“A trade deal between Valgsland and Sordland is possible.”
“I must admit I have been watching your rule with worry.”
“A response that I expected.”
“True. But I can certainly make your life harder.”
“Your actions are clear as day.”
“Then let's talk about your deal and we will call it a day.”
“My hand was forced when I made those decisions.”
entradas.menu: “My hand was forced when I made those decisions.”

entradas.text: “You have just lowered your chances of achieving a trade deal.”
entradas.menu: “You have just lowered your chances of achieving a trade deal.”

entradas.text: “Especially around those who are willing and ready to do precisely that.”
“That's enough! I didn't come here to hear threats. We are done here!”
entradas.menu: “That's enough! I didn't come here to hear threats. We are done here!”

entradas.text: “You don't have to like me to trade with Sordland.”
entradas.menu: “You don't have to like me to trade with Sordland.”

entradas.text: “Then it goes both ways, Chancellor Hegel.”
entradas.menu: “Then it goes both ways, Chancellor Hegel.”

entradas.text: “I expect nothing more.”
entradas.menu: “I expect nothing more.”

entradas.text: We started walking.
“Chancellor Hegel. Please. Sordland's concerns are Sordland's alone.”
entradas.menu: “Chancellor Hegel. Please. Sordland's concerns are Sordland's alone.”

entradas.text: “My problem is with you, Mr. Rayne. It's with how you lead Sordland.”
“From the looks of it, you need this more than I do.”
“I am even impartial to the trade deal you have made with those damn Agnolians.”
“No. My problem is not with the deal itself.”
“You banned completely legal organizations such as the Red Youth.”
“It's a good deal, really.”
“Here is what I am proposing.”
“Sordish fishing output from the Agnland region in return for Valgsland's hard-earned money.”
“Sordish wheat from the Bergia region in return for Valgsland's hard-earned money.”
“Sordish coal from the Lorren region in return for Valgsland's hard-earned money”
“Sordish tungsten in return for Valgsland's hard-earned money.”
“Good.”
“You accepted Arcasian aid and sold your sovereignty by letting them build bases.”
“You extended the emergency in your country with seemingly no end in sight.”
